members.lead: Victorian court to hand down decision on Friday on two appeals regarding Patterson’s triple murder case Erin Patterson mushroom murders appeal – live updates Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast Erin Patterson is set to find out if she could face a longer prison sentence or a new trial, as Victoria’s highest court hands down its decision on two appeals regarding her triple murder case. The court of appeal is set to rule on the two appeals from 10am on Friday, after justices Lesley Taylor, Stephen McLeish and Peter Kidd heard arguments from her legal team and prosecutors in August. members.lead: Ian Wilkinson not at court for appeal decision We’re still waiting outside the Victorian supreme court room where the appeal decisions will be heard. Unlike during the appeal hearings themselves in August, there are only a handful of representatives from the victims’ families in court. Ian Wilkinson, the only surviving victim of the beef wellington lunch, is not at court. Homicide squad detectives, including Stephen Eppingstall, the informant in the case, are among those waiting for the appeal. There’s a dozen or so members of the public here too, including some who attended every day of the trial in Morwell. The appeal decisions will be handed down in the Banco court, the supreme court’s ceremonial court.
